text: Level two, question three: a boat goes forty kilometres downstream in four hours and twenty-four kilometres upstream in four hours; find u and v. Question four: a man rows at six kilometres per hour in still water, and the stream flows at two; how long does he take to row sixteen kilometres downstream and back? Question five: a boat takes three times as long to go upstream as to cover the same distance downstream, and its still-water speed is sixteen kilometres per hour; find the stream speed.
